construction.label: Outdoor construction worker
construction.notes: Heavy sustained work in direct sun. The archetypal Indian heat-exposed informal worker.

delivery.label: Delivery rider
delivery.notes: Moderate continuous work, some convective relief from riding, but no shade and no control over timing.

child.label: School child, outdoors at midday
child.notes: Higher surface-area-to-mass ratio and lower sweat rate than an adult; also unlikely to self-regulate exposure.
child.basis: ISO 7243 limit + ACGIH work-rest allocation; includes a non-standard vulnerability offset of 2.0 degC

assessment_at_focus.label: School child, outdoors at midday
assessment_at_focus.basis: ISO 7243 limit + ACGIH work-rest allocation; includes a non-standard vulnerability offset of 2.0 degC

elderly.label: Woman, 78, indoors, on blood-pressure medication
elderly.notes: At rest, but with blunted thermoregulation: reduced sweat capacity, diminished thirst, and diuretics promoting dehydration. The offset is a judgement, not a standard.
elderly.basis: ISO 7243 limit + ACGIH work-rest allocation; includes a non-standard vulnerability offset of 4.0 degC

assessment_at_focus.label: Woman, 78, indoors, on blood-pressure medication
assessment_at_focus.basis: ISO 7243 limit + ACGIH work-rest allocation; includes a non-standard vulnerability offset of 4.0 degC
